activeStatement.title: Upload your current SIH problem statement from the Admin panel
activeStatement.description: This platform is intentionally statement-agnostic. Admins can replace the active statement, add resources and update role-specific learning plans without changing the application code.

roadmap.title: Understand
roadmap.text: Break the statement into problem, users, constraints and measurable outcomes.

roadmap.title: Research
roadmap.text: Collect references, validate assumptions and map existing solutions.

roadmap.title: Design
roadmap.text: Create user flows, wireframes, architecture and a realistic MVP.

roadmap.title: Build
roadmap.text: Develop the MVP in small, testable increments and track blockers.

roadmap.title: Polish
roadmap.text: Test, secure, document and prepare the final demonstration.

roadmap.title: Pitch
roadmap.text: Rehearse the story, live demo, impact metrics and likely jury questions.
